subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly Manila to Guangzhou on China Southern Airlines, take the high-speed train (2nd class) to Yangshuo and spend four nights in 4-star hotels in Yangshuo and Guilin. Highlights are the Li River cruise (Xingping section), Yulong River bamboo rafting, Silver Cave and Yangshuo West Street. A private coach and an English-speaking guide are included.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 29–Dec 3 2026 to Nov 29–Dec 3 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Elephant Trunk Hill: A riverside limestone hill in Guilin shaped like an elephant drinking from the Li River.
placeDesc.Sun and Moon Twin Towers: Two pagodas, one gold and one silver, standing in lakes in central Guilin and lit up at night.
placeDesc.Ronghu and Shanhu Scenic Area: A lakeside park in Guilin's city centre, known for its twin lakes.
placeDesc.Li River (Xingping): A scenic stretch of the Li River with karst peaks; the tour includes a cruise.
placeDesc.Silver Cave: A large karst cave near Yangshuo with colourful limestone formations.
placeDesc.Yulong River: A gentle river near Yangshuo, explored on a bamboo raft that seats 8.
placeDesc.Yangshuo West Street: A pedestrian street in Yangshuo old town with shops, cafes and nightlife.
placeDesc.Nanxi Park: A riverside park in Guilin with views of the Li River area.
placeDesc.East and West Alleys: A pair of old lanes in Guilin's centre with traditional-style shops and eateries.
placeDesc.Xiaoyao Tower: A tower in Guilin with a viewing platform over the river and city.
